pages.quiz:
INTEGRATED SCIENCE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: INTEGRATED SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Ice melting to water

2. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Only carbon dioxide

3. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 37 °C

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Human Excretory System? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Human Excretory System.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Human Excretory System.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Human Excretory System.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Human Excretory System.

5. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Magnetism? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Magnetism.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Magnetism.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Magnetism.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Magnetism.

7. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. newton (N)
   C. joule (J)
   D. watt (W)

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Mixtures? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Mixtures.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Mixtures.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Mixtures.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Mixtures.

9. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Overgrazing continuously

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Laboratory apparatus and instruments? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Laboratory apparatus and instruments.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Laboratory apparatus and instruments.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Laboratory apparatus and instruments.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Laboratory apparatus and instruments.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Integrated Science? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Integrated Science.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Integrated Science.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Integrated Science.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Integrated Science.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Human Reproductive System? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Human Reproductive System.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Human Reproductive System.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Human Reproductive System.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Human Reproductive System.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Laboratory Safety and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Laboratory apparatus and instruments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Mixtures and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Acids, Bases and Indicators and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

2. A — Glucose and oxygen

5. B — Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

6. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Magnetism.

9. B — Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

12. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Human Reproductive System.
